content: LibreWolf debrands Firefox via mozconfig --with-branding=browser/branding/librewolf plus a patch set, and keeps preference defaults in a SEPARATE settings repo that emits librewolf.cfg and policies.json (with a user-facing librewolf.overrides.cfg). Architectural lesson: brand identity and preference/policy defaults are deliberately different artifacts with different change cadence - do not merge prefs into the branding manifest.
